speaker: Doctor
text: I see you have a history of gait and limb ataxia; to better understand the underlying cause, have you noticed any specific triggers or worsening patterns in your symptoms, and do you have a history of alcohol use or vitamin deficiencies?

speaker: Patient
text: I started having trouble walking recently, and people say I look drunk when I walk. I also feel clumsy in my arms and legs, especially on the right side.

speaker: Doctor
text: That clumsiness on the right side is significant; could you tell me if you have experienced any vision changes, such as double vision or trouble distinguishing colors, or if you have a family history of similar neurological issues? Additionally, have you noticed any numbness in your feet or hands?

speaker: Patient
text: I have Crohn disease and it has been difficult to control. I have been taking natalizumab for about a year.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Progressive Multifocal Leukoencephalopathy (PML) secondary to natalizumab therapy. REQUEST IMAGES: MRI Brain with and without contrast. REQUEST TEST: CSF JC Virus PCR.
